content.headline: 24/7 Flatbed Towing.
content.subheadline: 24/7 flatbed towing and recovery out of North Haverhill, New Hampshire. Serving the Twin States.
content.about: Finish Line Towing is Joshua Aldrich. Local, owner-operated flatbed towing and recovery out of North Haverhill — serving the Twin States since 2012. The truck rolls 24/7; the phone goes to him, not a call center. In his words: "I started in this business as an opportunity to provide for our area, with services much needed."

faq.a: After 8pm until 5am, call the pager — (603) 615-6750. During the day, call Josh’s cell — (603) 252-5568. Either way you’re reaching him, not a call center.

faq.q: Is it a flatbed or a wheel-lift?
faq.a: Flatbed. Your vehicle rides on the deck instead of being dragged on two wheels, which is what you want for anything low, all-wheel drive, classic, or already damaged.
585 Benton Road, North Haverhill, NH 03774, in Grafton County.

faq.q: How long have you been doing this?
faq.a: Finish Line Towing, LLC was formed in July 2021 and is registered and in good standing with the State of New Hampshire.

content.legal: Rates depend on distance, vehicle, and conditions, and are quoted before the truck rolls.

reviews.author: Richie Veilleux
reviews.text: Great response time, friendly and affordable!!

reviews.author: Beck DiChristopher
reviews.text: Josh was fantastic! Excellent communication! Arrived when he said he would which can be hard with his line of work. He's friendly and towed my truck with a smile! I definitely recommend this family owned business!

reviews.author: Alfred R. Porcaro III
reviews.text: If you're ever down and out on your luck you can count on this company to have your back! The best in the industry — professional, knowledgeable and extremely helpful.

reviews.author: Chris Baj
reviews.text: We just had Finish Line Towing bring our camper from NH to Massachusetts. Would highly recommend Josh and his team with your property! Awesome service and great people!!
